approval.reason: Reviewed 1.0.1 source diff: adds cache.js exporting saveCache(path, value) = fs.writeFileSync(path, value, 'utf8'). This matches the release notes exactly ("optional saveCache for caller-selected local output"). Both path and value are caller-supplied arguments (no hardcoded paths, no network access, no data exfiltration, no obfuscation). The pre-existing format() function is byte-identical to 1.0.0. The filesystem-write capability flag is an expected, low-risk consequence of this documented opt-in feature, not a hidden or unrelated behavior change. Approving the capability escalation so the gate reflects this reviewed, intentional addition.
